scientific_question: Can the frozen exact step-25 existential operation be completed without changing Boolean semantics by spilling one exact restriction message into a content-addressed external representation, rebuilding the other branch in a fresh arena, releasing the original pre-restriction arena, then reloading only the two exact output messages into a fresh combine arena before the original OR?

candidate_mechanism.name: EXACT_CONTENT_ADDRESSED_MESSAGE_SPILL_RELOAD
candidate_mechanism.phase_1: Replay exact R27 prehistory through step 24 and exact local AND at step 25.
candidate_mechanism.phase_2: Compute restrict(false) exactly; serialize only its reachable output DAG into a deterministic content-addressed message; verify deserialize-roundtrip structural identity; then discard the active DAG arena.
candidate_mechanism.phase_3: Independently replay the identical frozen prehistory/local-AND; compute restrict(true) exactly; serialize and roundtrip-verify its reachable output DAG; then discard the active DAG arena.
candidate_mechanism.phase_4: Create a fresh combine arena; import only the two exact serialized output DAGs with deterministic structural interning; verify imported roots are structurally identical to their serialized messages; execute the original frozen OR and no substitute operator.
candidate_mechanism.phase_5: If the OR completes, normalize the factor set exactly as R27 and continue the frozen elimination schedule only if the preregistered resource gates remain satisfied.
